description: Compare ski passes on price, resort coverage, and value — the tool for "which season pass includes <resort> — Epic or Ikon?" (pass resortSlugs=[<resort>]). Optionally pass resortSlugs you plan to ski and tripDays to see which pass covers them and whether it beats buying window lift tickets.

dailyTicketUsd.description: Override the assumed window ticket rate (default $185)

resortSlugs.description: Resorts you plan to ski — used for coverage scoring

tripDays.description: Total days you plan to ski (for the value calc)

name: compare_passes

markdown.description: Human-readable markdown summary of the tool result (may be omitted when structuredContent carries a typed payload; content[0].text always has the prose).

title: Compare ski passes
